name: Statistical
keywords: Statistical, Array, Stream, FILO, Average, RMS, Sigma, Quartile, IQR, Variance, Regression, Slope, Offset, R2, Vector, Sensor, Filter, Embedded
description: Ultra-low-RAM statistical library for Arduino and embedded systems. Provides array statistics (arithmetic/geometric/RMS/sigma averages, quartile, IQR, standard deviation, variance), heap-free FILO sliding window, online stream statistics (Welford algorithm), ordinary least-squares linear regression with Compute_All(), and polar vector addition.
